description: This is a C source file implementing a driver for the CMOS RTC as a monotonic counter in Zephyr OS, including functions for reading RTC state, converting BCD, and calculating epoch time.

methods.name: read_state
methods.description: Populates a state struct with current RTC state by reading CMOS registers.

methods.name: decode_bcd
methods.description: Converts an 8-bit BCD value to its binary equivalent.

methods.name: hinnant
methods.description: Calculates days offset from epoch using Hinnant's algorithm.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Reads the current RTC time, normalizes it, and converts it to Unix epoch time.
